citation.authors: Young MM, Franken A, du Plessis JL

record.population: 19 African and 31 Caucasian female South African nursing students
record.design: Measurement of water loss, stratum corneum hydration and skin surface pH
record.finding: No difference in water loss between groups. Stratum corneum hydration was lower (P<=0.05) and surface pH higher (P<=0.0001) in the African students. The authors suggest a higher risk of occupational skin disease.
record.note: The abstract says conflicting evidence exists on barrier function between groups; this is one small study.
